description:
The provider name '(openrouter)' appears as a prefix in the status bar for the Elixir version but not in the Node.js version.

OBSERVED (Elixir - left):
...1.5%/197k (auto)  (openrouter) minimax/minimax

EXPECTED (Node.js - right):
...1.8%/197k (auto)  minimax/minimax-m2.7

The '(openrouter)' text should not appear in the status bar. The model name should be displayed cleanly without provider prefix.
title: TUI-9: (openrouter) prefix in status bar vs no prefix in Node.js
